$comment: Auto-generated from app/events.py. Each WebSocket message is a JSON object: {"type": "<event_type>", "data": <payload>}. The client also sends "ping" as plain text; the server replies {"type": "pong"}.

flood_scope_override.description: Per-channel outbound flood scope override, tri-state: null = inherit the global app setting; '*' (UNSCOPED_OVERRIDE_MARKER) = force unscoped/plain flood even over a scoped global; a region name (e.g. '#Esperance') = scope this channel.
flood_scope_override.title: Flood Scope Override

path_hash_mode_override.description: Per-channel path hash mode override (0=1-byte, 1=2-byte, 2=3-byte, null = use radio default)
path_hash_mode_override.title: Path Hash Mode Override

radio_residency.description: Current confidence in radio residency: database_only when the channel is local, confirmed when its slot was verified in this radio generation, and stale when a previous residency claim has not been verified in the current generation.
radio_residency.title: Radio Residency

channel_deleted.description: A channel was removed from the database.

contact.description: Contact created or updated (from advertisements, radio sync, or API).

path.description: Hex-encoded path bytes (empty string for direct/flood)
path.title: Path

contact_deleted.description: A contact was removed from the database.

contact_resolved.description: A prefix-only placeholder contact was resolved to a full public key.

path.description: Hex-encoded path bytes (empty string for direct/flood)
path.title: Path

error.description: Toast-level error notification (e.g., radio setup failure, missing private key).

health.description: Radio connection status. Sent on WS connect and on every state change.

RadioStatsSnapshot.description: Latest cached stats from the local radio's periodic 60s poll.
RadioStatsSnapshot.title: RadioStatsSnapshot

message.description: New or incoming message (DM or channel). Includes outgoing messages sent by this radio.

MessagePath.description: A single path that a message took to reach us.

path_len.description: Hop count. None = legacy (infer as len(path)//2, i.e. 1-byte hops)
path_len.title: Path Len

received_at.description: Unix timestamp when this path was received
received_at.title: Received At

MessagePath.title: MessagePath

conversation_key.description: User pubkey for PRIV, channel key for CHAN
conversation_key.title: Conversation Key

packet_id.description: Representative raw packet row ID when archival raw bytes exist
packet_id.title: Packet Id

paths.description: List of routing paths this message arrived via
paths.title: Paths

region.description: Resolved region name for the transport code, if it matched a known region
region.title: Region

transport_code.description: Region scope transport code (uint16) when the message arrived via a TransportFlood/TransportDirect packet; None for unscoped (plain flood) messages
transport_code.title: Transport Code

message_acked.description: An existing message received an ACK or echo/repeat update.

MessagePath.description: A single path that a message took to reach us.

path_len.description: Hop count. None = legacy (infer as len(path)//2, i.e. 1-byte hops)
path_len.title: Path Len

received_at.description: Unix timestamp when this path was received
received_at.title: Received At

MessagePath.title: MessagePath

radio_activity.description: Sanitized inbound radio observation, deduplicate by sequence; refetch activity after reconnect.

payload_schema.description: Only classification and opaque reliable job correlation; no RF payloads.
payload_schema.title: RadioActivityRecord

radio_job.description: Sanitized job snapshot delta. Merge by ID/version; refetch jobs after WebSocket reconnect.

RadioJobKind.description: Safe, fixed identifiers; never use arbitrary command or target strings.
RadioJobKind.title: RadioJobKind

RadioJobResult.description: Outcome codes only, not arbitrary exception messages or radio payloads.
RadioJobResult.title: RadioJobResult

RadioJobStage.description: Predefined user-facing phase labels; never arbitrary transport text.
RadioJobStage.title: RadioJobStage

payload_schema.description: Frozen JSON-safe view. No command inputs or untrusted free-text fields.
payload_schema.title: RadioJobSnapshot

raw_packet.description: Every incoming RF packet (pre-decryption). Use observation_id as the dedup key, not id.

RawPacketDecryptedInfo.description: Decryption info for a raw packet (when successfully decrypted).
RawPacketDecryptedInfo.title: RawPacketDecryptedInfo

payload_schema.description:
Raw packet payload broadcast via WebSocket.

This extends the database model with runtime-computed fields
like payload_type, snr, rssi, and decryption info.

observation_id.description: Monotonic per-process ID for this RF observation (distinct from the DB packet row ID)
observation_id.title: Observation Id

region.description: Resolved region name for the transport code, if it matched a known region
region.title: Region

transport_code.description: Region scope transport code (uint16) for TransportFlood/TransportDirect packets
transport_code.title: Transport Code

payload_schema.title: RawPacketBroadcast

success.description: Toast-level success notification (e.g., historical decrypt complete).
